CA.Gov.ECCC.Hydro.Kafka.description: Kafka producer endpoint for ECCC Water Office CloudEvents on the `canada-eccc-wateroffice` topic keyed by `stations/{station_number}`.

CA.Gov.ECCC.Hydro.Mqtt.description: MQTT 5 producer endpoint for canada-eccc-wateroffice CloudEvents using the documented UNS topic hierarchy.

CA.Gov.ECCC.Hydro.Amqp.description: AMQP 1.0 producer endpoint for canada-eccc-wateroffice CloudEvents on the configured broker address.

CA.Gov.ECCC.Hydro.Station.name: Station
CA.Gov.ECCC.Hydro.Station.description: A reference record for one Canadian hydrometric station published by Environment and Climate Change Canada Water Survey of Canada. It fires when the bridge publishes or refreshes the station catalog so consumers can interpret measurement events.

CA.Gov.ECCC.Hydro.Observation.name: Observation
CA.Gov.ECCC.Hydro.Observation.description: A current measurement from Environment and Climate Change Canada Water Survey of Canada for one monitoring site. It carries real-time water level and flow observations when the upstream feed reports a new or refreshed value.

CA.Gov.ECCC.Hydro.description: Events from ECCC Water Office covering Canadian hydrometric stations and their current measurements. Use the reference records to identify stations and the measurement records for the latest observations.

CA.Gov.ECCC.Hydro.mqtt.description: MQTT 5 variant of canada-eccc-wateroffice events with UNS topics for wildcard subscribers.

CA.Gov.ECCC.Hydro.amqp.description: AMQP 1.0 variant of canada-eccc-wateroffice events for queue-oriented consumers and Azure Service Bus.

schema.name: Station
schema.description: Reference data for a Water Survey of Canada hydrometric monitoring station from the ECCC OGC API hydrometric-stations collection.

station_number.description: Unique WSC station identifier following the scheme 2-digit major drainage area + letter + station digits, e.g. '05BJ004'. Upstream field: STATION_NUMBER.

station_name.description: Official name of the hydrometric station, e.g. 'ELBOW RIVER AT BRAGG CREEK'. Upstream field: STATION_NAME.

prov_terr_state_loc.description: Two-letter province, territory or state location code where the station is situated, e.g. 'AB' for Alberta. Upstream field: PROV_TERR_STATE_LOC.

status_en.description: Operational status of the station in English, e.g. 'Active', 'Discontinued'. Upstream field: STATUS_EN.

contributor_en.description: Name of the contributing agency responsible for operating this station in English, e.g. 'Water Survey of Canada'. Upstream field: CONTRIBUTOR_EN.

drainage_area_gross.description: Gross drainage area of the watershed upstream of this station in square kilometres. Upstream field: DRAINAGE_AREA_GROSS.

drainage_area_effect.description: Effective (contributing) drainage area of the watershed upstream of this station in square kilometres, excluding non-contributing areas. Upstream field: DRAINAGE_AREA_EFFECT.

rhbn.description: Indicates whether the station is part of the Reference Hydrometric Basin Network (RHBN), a subset of hydrologically stable, minimally disturbed basins used for climate change studies. Upstream field: RHBN.

real_time.description: Indicates whether real-time data are available for this station via the WSC real-time data service. Upstream field: REAL_TIME.

latitude.description: Geographic latitude of the station in decimal degrees (WGS84), derived from the GeoJSON geometry coordinates.

longitude.description: Geographic longitude of the station in decimal degrees (WGS84), derived from the GeoJSON geometry coordinates.

basin.description: Stable routing axis used by MQTT and AMQP transport templates for canada-eccc-wateroffice.

schema.name: Observation
schema.description: Real-time hydrometric observation from the ECCC OGC API hydrometric-realtime collection. Data are provisional and updated approximately every 5 minutes.

station_number.description: Unique WSC station identifier, e.g. '05BJ004'. Upstream field: STATION_NUMBER.

identifier.description: Unique observation identifier composed of station number and ISO 8601 observation datetime, e.g. '05BJ004.2026-03-07T07:00:00Z'. Upstream field: IDENTIFIER.

station_name.description: Official name of the hydrometric station. Upstream field: STATION_NAME.

prov_terr_state_loc.description: Two-letter province, territory or state location code. Upstream field: PROV_TERR_STATE_LOC.

observation_datetime.description: Timestamp of the observation in UTC. Upstream field: DATETIME.

level.description: Water level at the station gauge in metres above the station datum. Null when not measured or unavailable. Upstream field: LEVEL.

discharge.description: Water discharge (flow rate) at the station in cubic metres per second. Null when not measured or unavailable. Upstream field: DISCHARGE.

latitude.description: Geographic latitude of the station in decimal degrees (WGS84), derived from the GeoJSON geometry coordinates.

longitude.description: Geographic longitude of the station in decimal degrees (WGS84), derived from the GeoJSON geometry coordinates.

basin.description: Stable routing axis used by MQTT and AMQP transport templates for canada-eccc-wateroffice.

description: ECCC Water Office publishes real-time water level and flow observations from Environment and Climate Change Canada Water Survey of Canada for Canadian hydrometric stations. These events let consumers build real-time monitoring, alerting, and operational dashboards without polling the upstream API directly.
